_comment: Which Open Food Facts countries_tags a product must carry to be considered.
tier1 is the home market: eligible to auto-load if it also clears the quality
gate. tier2 is everything else on Romanian shelves -- imported brands, border
trade -- and can never auto-load, only reach the review queue. A product sold
only in Hungary is noise to someone typing Romanian into the search box, so a
human decides rather than a threshold.
Measured 2026-07-27: a Romania query returns count 10000 with
is_count_exact false, so the true tier1 size is unknown until the first full
